apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/tasks/T09.aria.yml — "Reactivated \"Legacy attic\" was recorded in Legacy attic’s history."
apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/tasks/T05.aria.yml — "Undid: Removed the Markdown section."
Straight quotes here; curly quotes in the activity feed and More-menu confirmation (“…”)
repro: 3. Add workstream "Baseline workstream" with parent Kitchen
4. Read the notice under the header
findings.expected: Confirmation notices read as plain sentences about what happened.
findings.actual: Notices join a stored history label to a fixed phrase, producing ungrammatical sentences ("Created \"X\" was recorded in X’s history.", "Undid: Removed the …"). Quote style switches between straight and curly within the same view.
findings.heuristic: Internal consistency; Nielsen #2 Match between system and the real world

findings.surface: removal notice › "Undo is in the header"
evidence: apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/kitchen-remove-feedback-light-1440.aria.yml — status "Removed the Markdown section. Undo is in the header."

apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/kitchen-more-light-1440.png — header undo/redo controls are unlabeled arrow icons (top right); their names exist only as accessible names "Undo: …"

Inferred variants: "Saved. Undo is in the header.", "This section was already removed. Undo is in the header.", "This project's header Undo may reverse the latest step when available." (project-page-store.ts, todos-page.html)
repro: 4. Look for something labelled "Undo" in the header
findings.expected: Copy that sends the user to a control uses words the user can see on that control.
findings.actual: The notice sends the user to "Undo", but nothing visible in the header says Undo; there are two arrow icons. "Header" is also a layout term. The Todos wording "may reverse the latest step when available" hedges twice.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #6 Recognition rather than recall

findings.surface: Todos page › name
evidence: apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/todos-light-1440.aria.yml — nav link "Todos" opens a page whose region and h2 are "What is coming up"; description "Everything under this project, in due-date order."

repro: 3. Click Todos in the project column

findings.surface: Reflections page and section › naming
evidence: apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/reflections-light-1440.png — eyebrow "PROJECT JOURNAL", h1 "Reflections", card "Write a reflection" with corner label "Reflections", card "Journal", and on entries "About Approve the lighting plan · Done"
apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/nested-projects-project-light-1440.aria.yml — entry footnote "About completed work · see Reflections"

repro: 3. Read the eyebrow, heading and card titles
findings.expected: The feature has one name, and its storage structure is not part of the copy.

findings.surface: Archive page and archived-projects page › wording
evidence: apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/archive-light-1440.png — eyebrow "PROJECT RECOVERY", h2 "Archive", card heading "ARCHIVE" again; each row ends "Archived directly"; markdown row adds "Keeps its text"
apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/archive-light-1440.aria.yml — "Restore a listed item to reveal any independently archived work inside it."
apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/settings-archived-projects-light-1440.aria.yml — "Its separately archived contents remain in Archive."
Inferred cause labels: "Archived with its section", "Archived with its task", "Hidden by an archived project", "Content this version cannot read — kept to be safe" (archived-region.ts)
findings.expected: Archive rows explain how the item got there in everyday words, using one term for one idea.

findings.heuristic: Nielsen #2 Match between system and the real world; Nielsen #8 Aesthetic and minimalist design

findings.surface: unsupported/unbuilt fallbacks › "build" and raw type names
findings.state: unknown section / unbuilt page / unimplemented widget
evidence: Inferred: project-canvas.html — "Unrecognised section" / "Nothing in this build knows how to render a “<type>” section." (raw stored type id)
Inferred: shortcut-frame.html — "This source section type is not available in this build."
Inferred: project-page-registry.ts — "There is no “<kind>” page. Showing Home instead." (raw URL segment) and "The <Label> page is not built yet."
Inferred: dashboard-page.html — "The <type with _ replaced> widget is not built yet." (e.g. "work summary")
Inferred: archived-region.ts — "Content this version cannot read — kept to be safe"
findings.expected: Fallbacks explain the situation without referring to builds, versions or stored identifiers.
findings.actual: Fallback copy talks about "this build" and "this version" and echoes raw type or URL identifiers inside curly quotes, so the user sees how the software is put together rather than what to do.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #2 Match between system and the real world; Nielsen #9 Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors

findings.surface: Settings › AI & Agents › permission labels
evidence: apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/settings-agents-light-1440.aria.yml — "Read projects / Modify projects / Read tasks / Modify tasks / Read reflections / Write reflections / Read workspace overview"
